text:
lina (Sales Ops): Heads-up: Monsoon Cloud (reseller/co-sell) raised a formal dispute. They say customer was billed at public hosted rates after migrating to Dedicated mid-quarter. Billed amount = $180,000 for May invoice INV-2026-0515. Reseller asks for a 35% retroactive discount on the billed amount and asks us to adjust reseller commission. Need deal-desk review.
marcus (RevOps): Context: customer had negotiated reseller price schedule (reseller SKU discount) but our billing pipeline used hosted pricing due to a mapping bug when account moved to Dedicated. Audit attached: usage + invoice mapping. Exposure if we grant full 35% = $63,000. We also owe reseller a commission recalculation; current commission payout was based on full $180k.
tara (Account Exec): Customer is upset and says they will consolidate with the reseller long-term if we don't make them whole. They prefer a one-time credit vs. month-by-month. My ask: act quickly to avoid churn — customer said 30% would close the issue.
peter (Finance): Rules: any one-off credit > $50k needs Sr Finance + VP signoff. Also need to capture GL treatment: propose split approach to limit immediate hit. Provide proposed journal entries and close period. Who will own NetSuite execution?
rachel (Revenue Ops): Proposal: 30% one-time economic concession = $54k, split as $30k immediate credit (NetSuite CM) + $24k applied as future billing credit across next 3 months. Reseller commission: recalc on net revenue (post-concession) and issue clawback if already paid. Condition: reseller signs margin-adjustment amendment and customer signs an addendum committing to 12-month term renewal.
oliver (Legal): I can draft both amendments (customer + reseller) with clawback language. Need exact numbers and effective dates. Also recommend a clause that this is a one-time remedial credit and not precedent.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route created for thread 1798765432. Outstanding approvals required: VP Finance signoff, CRO approval, Legal amendment signoff. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1798765432
peter (Finance): Provisional: Finance will approve up to $55k provided split treatment and signed amendments are attached prior to posting. If final concession > $55k, route to VP Finance. Need NetSuite CM template filed to BILL-4690.
arjun (CRO): Need ARR/NRR impact. If customer signs 12-month renewal and reseller agrees to revised margin, I can approve $54k concession to protect retention. Scheduling a 10-min sync now to confirm.
lina (Sales Ops): Next steps checklist: 1) Tara to secure customer verbal on 30% + 12-month renewal 2) Marcus to prepare usage audit and NetSuite CM draft 3) Oliver draft amendments 4) Peter to prepare journal entries and wait for attachments 5) Arjun to confirm at sync. Closing criteria: signed customer + reseller amendments uploaded and NetSuite credit memo posted.
tara (Account Exec): On the call now with customer, they're open to 12-month and will sign if we do 30% and adjust reseller commission as suggested. Will upload signed docs when complete.
lina (Sales Ops): Thanks all — tagging for approvals and audit trail.
